svg.title: Measured copy protocol — corrected-v2 validation and commit
svg.desc: Implemented in probe-common.hpp and both native adapters; not a live game snapshot API.

g.text: Measured copy protocol — corrected-v2 validation and commit
Root exact Float64Array and its backing owner
Reject wrong type, empty, detached, oversized; validate offset and byte length without overflow.
Borrow bytes only during synchronous copy
No JavaScript calls while borrowing; memcpy into candidate[749]; native storage is independent.
Validate all elements and accumulated sum
Two finite Number.MAX_VALUE values overflow the sum; reject before committing any native slot.
Commit complete candidate or preserve previous state
Regression checks all 749 slots, count=3 and sum=6 after rejected overflow input.
Implemented in probe-common.hpp and both native adapters; not a live game snapshot API.
